suggestions.assertion: Figures are right: the report states that auth-service has 6 dependents and accounts for 11 of the 36 Q3 incidents
suggestions.reason: '11 of 36' is the naive count. The fixture has a deliberate duplicate (11 Jul gateway SEV1 'caused by auth-service SEV1') and three more gateway incidents naming auth-service, so a careful report can headline '14 of 35'. This run printed 11 and 36 as separate facts and headlined 14 of 35, which passes on a literal reading but could be graded either way. Reword to 'states that auth-service logged 11 of the 36 Q3 records (and says so if it de-duplicates the 11 Jul pair)', and add checks for other planted figures (148 tests, 18,000 USD, order by 5 Nov, 54 days, 4-hour RTO).

suggestions.assertion: Glance first: the first section after the title is a one-screen overview that states the conclusion itself...
suggestions.reason: Passes on line count (panel is lines 6-42), yet a panel with long paragraphs, a 5-row wrapped table and an 800 px-wide picture renders at roughly two screens, and the executor itself says ~1.3. Consider a stricter or rendered-height criterion (e.g. verdict and ask visible without scrolling, panel text <= 40 lines excluding the image).

suggestions.assertion: Headings tell the story: at least half of the body headings state a claim, finding or question...
suggestions.reason: 'Body headings' is ambiguous. Here 4-5 of 6 human-part headings are claims, but only 4-5 of 11 if the plain-label machine-zone headings (A-D, banner) are counted. Say 'headings in the human part'.

suggestions.assertion: Evidence out of the way: bulky raw material (the 36 incident rows, the full inventory table, long logs) is not in the human part...
suggestions.reason: Unclear whether a compact, derived 9-row readiness table in the human part counts as 'the full inventory table'. Specify what is not allowed (e.g. a verbatim dump with runtime and depends_on columns, or more than N raw rows).

Nothing checks that the AI-input part is actually usable by an agent (state, files, commands, constraints, next steps). Assertion 1 would pass with a bare 'AI input' heading over nothing; this run's block A is good but unchecked. Likewise nothing checks that proposals and assumptions are kept apart from facts from the notes (this run does it well with a claim register).

eval_feedback.overall: Solid structural assertions that this output genuinely meets. They check presence and placement but are lenient on density (one-screen), ambiguous on scope ('body headings', 'full inventory table'), and check only two planted figures. Content correctness beyond those two numbers is not asserted.
